resources.string: Drawing surface. Use Draw, Erase or Move view. Control Z undoes; Control Shift Z redoes.
Drag across the drawing to select a region and its intersecting strokes.
Finger, mouse or pen. Pen pressure is used when reported by the device. The eraser removes whole strokes.
This drawing or recovery draft cannot be read safely. It will not be overwritten. Close and keep the original.
Drawing limit reached. Lift the pen; undo or erase strokes to make room.
This change is too large or could not be saved. The previous draft is kept. Undo or erase some strokes.
Finished strokes form a local recovery draft. Cancel discards this draft without changing the saved drawing.
